description: Source code for a Blink IDL parser using PLY (Python Lex-Yacc), extending a base Web IDL parser, with custom rules and extensions for Blink-specific IDL syntax.

classes.name: BlinkIDLParser
classes.description: A subclass of IDLParser that overrides certain grammar rules to support Blink-specific Web IDL syntax.

methods.name: p_Definitions
methods.description: Grammar rule for parsing Blink IDL definitions, overriding the base parser to set the start symbol.

methods.name: p_ConstValue
methods.description: Parser rule for various constant value literals including booleans, floats, integers, strings, and null.

methods.name: p_IntegerLiteral
methods.description: Parser rule for integer literals, creating a list of attributes for type and name.

methods.name: p_StringLiteral
methods.description: Parser rule for string literals, creating a list of attributes for type and name.

methods.name: p_ExceptionMember
methods.description: Parser rule for exception members, including constants, fields, attributes, and operations.

methods.name: p_Attribute
methods.description: Parser rule for attribute declarations with 'ReadOnly' and 'ATTRIBUTE'.

methods.name: p_ExceptionOperation
methods.description: Parser rule for exception operations with type and identifier.

methods.name: p_ExtendedAttributeList
methods.description: Parser rule for extended attribute lists, overriding base parser to remove comments.

methods.name: p_ExtendedAttributeListError
methods.description: Error handling rule for extended attribute list parsing errors.

methods.name: p_ExtendedAttributes
methods.description: Parser rule allowing optional trailing comma in extended attributes, Blink-specific.

methods.name: p_ExtendedAttribute
methods.description: Parser rule for various extended attribute forms, including Blink extensions for string literals.

methods.name: p_ExtendedAttributeStringLiteral
methods.description: Blink extension: support for string literal extended attribute with '='.

methods.name: p_ExtendedAttributeStringLiteralList
methods.description: Blink extension: support for list of string literals in extended attribute.

methods.name: p_StringLiteralList
methods.description: Parser rule for list of string literals, extracting string values.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for BlinkIDLParser, setting up lexer, parser, and options.
